strings.El Patrón Profesional de Embarcaciones d: The Professional Skipper of Recreational Boats allows boats to be operated for professional purposes within their powers. strings.El Técnico Deportivo en Barrancos acredi: The Canyoning Sports Technician accredits specific training to guide descents with rope, water, rappelling, jumps, slides and progression on technical terrain. The basic mechanics of BTT allow us to resolve common incidents on mountain bike routes.
strings.El Técnico Deportivo en Escalada acredit: The Sports Climbing Technician accredits specific training in vertical progression, wall safety, belaying and management of rope activities. IRATA type training is related to vertical work and technical maneuvers at height. Self-rescue and vertical rescue allow action in the event of blockages, rope incidents or evacuations in exposed areas. Dynamic systems are especially important because these jumps generate different forces than a conventional rappel or climb.
strings.El Técnico Deportivo en Espeleología acr: The Sports Technician in Speleology accredits preparation to guide activities in caves, chasms and underground environments with technical criteria. Vertical rope progression allows you to work in wells, ledges and uneven areas. Self-help in cavities is essential because underground help may take longer to arrive. The topography and underground orientation help interpret routes, galleries and exit points. The conservation of cavities ensures a respectful practice with geological formations and sensitive ecosystems.
strings.El Técnico Deportivo en Media Montaña ac: The Mid-Mountain Sports Technician accredits preparation to guide in non-technical terrain, plan routes and manage groups. Orientation and cartography allow you to move with a map, compass, GPS and terrain references. Bushcraft brings together traditional autonomy skills such as shelter, fire, water, knots and reading the environment. Remote first aid is essential when assistance may take time.
strings.El título de Técnico Deportivo en Escala: The title of Sports Technician in Climbing and Medium Mountains accredits specific training to guide, teach and manage mountain activities with technical and safety criteria. First aid in remote areas reinforces the response capacity when an activity takes place far from immediate assistance.

strings.La formación como instructor de parapent: Training as a paragliding, paramotor and paratrike instructor accredits the ability to teach flight progression, glider control, takeoffs, landings and air safety. strings.La formación como instructor de SUP, win: Training as a SUP, wingfoil and kitesurf instructor accredits the ability to teach board and wind sports progressively, from basic balance to direction control, speed and safety. Aquatic lifesaving, rescue with a support boat and wind and wave reading are essential for working in the open sea or areas with maritime traffic.
strings.La formación de yoga 500 horas aporta un: The 500-hour yoga training provides extensive preparation to guide mobility, breathing, body awareness and safe practice.
